Here is a rewrite of that technical breakdown into simple, everyday language, keeping your specific adjustments in mind.
What is GatewayGuard?
GatewayGuard is an open-source design that enforces built-in Windows 11 Home and Pro security features. Unlike traditional antivirus software, it does not slow down your computer, cause system lag, or use telemetry—the automated process of collecting, transmitting, and analyzing your data. Instead of forcing you to install mysterious, hidden software, it simply automates and turns on the powerful, enterprise-grade protections already built right into Windows.
Why IT Professionals Trust It
To prove its system reliability, GatewayGuard relies on facts rather than flashy marketing claims:
Zero-Bloat Design: It acts only as a setup tool to turn on built-in Windows security features. Once it finishes changing a setting, it completely shuts off. It leaves zero apps running in the background and takes up none of your computer's memory.
Total Code Transparency: The entire program is written in plain, readable text scripts. This means anyone—from everyday users to security experts—can read through it line-by-line and see exactly what settings or rules it is changing before running it.
You Are in Control: It will never make major changes or restart your computer out of nowhere. For big actions (like running a deep boot scan), it stops and asks for your permission first so you don't lose any open work.
Plays Nice with Other Software: It doesn't try to replace your current antivirus. Instead, it builds a rock-solid foundation for your computer. If it detects you are using other tools (like Malwarebytes), it automatically adjusts itself to work perfectly alongside them.
